scheme_name: Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Labour Welfare Fund must have been regularly paid by the organization/unit for the last one year
Applicant must be a Shramyogi working in the organized sector of Gujarat
Male Shramyogis must be above 45 years of age; female Shramyogis must be above 35 years of age
Benefit is provided once a year per worker
Medical examination must be completed within 30 days after in‑principle approval, with mutual agreement of the company and the hospital
The company must upload an Excel sheet listing the workers on the portal
Fees paid under the scheme are non‑refundable
Final decision rests with the Welfare Commissioner; jurisdiction is Ahmedabad
benefits_summary: Provides a full medical check‑up for eligible Shramyogis, with a fixed amount of ₹1950 per worker of which the organization pays 25% (₹487.50).
